BiblicalUsage: Humtah is a town in the hill country of Judah, named once in the list of the tribe's inheritance. No story is attached to it, and no person is tied to its name. It stands in the record because the land was divided town by town, and every town counted.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Humtah matters because God gave His people a real land with real towns, and no part of the inheritance was too small to record.
